sharedDraftNotes: Use only the blocks already available in the repository.
Ground the design in graph-based preflight validation before building the flow.

notes: Prefer publishable title quality over generic keyword stuffing.
Keep downstream output JSON-shaped and machine-readable.
Make repeated outputs explicit in the prompt wording and keep the requested count stable.

reflectionNotes: Prefer deterministic sample execution before accepting the design.
If the request needs capabilities that available blocks do not provide, stop early instead of forcing an invalid flow.
